description: Dated category, operator and individual-market observations retained at each successful collection. Raw Hyperliquid OI observations count both sides, as reported by the API. Published OI counts each contract once. Rolling volumes overlap and must not be summed as calendar-month volume. Uncollected periods remain missing.
